[[File:Jedi_on_Tython_EGTW.jpg|thumb|150px|Several Jedi meditating at the Waterfalls of Akar Kesh]]
The '''Waterfalls of Akar Kesh''' was a region on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] located by the [[Tho Yor]] monolith known as [[Akar Kesh]]. Numerous islands dotted the region and the various rivers were fed from the waterfalls. This environment created a tranquil setting that was perfect for meditation due to its isolated nature.

After the [[Despot War]], [[Je'daii]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rajivari]] departed active service from the [[Je'daii Order]] in order to contemplate on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Following the arrival of the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], [[Je'daii Master]] [[Ketu]] went to the Waterfalls of Akar Kesh to seek the advice of Rajivari concerning a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]].
